note: Reproduced: hub registry.pm_commit ran git status --porcelain .project/ from the hub root, which is silent for the ignored worktree, so every commit returned nothing_to_commit. Fix: status/add/diff/commit run inside the store; git rev-parse --show-prefix (".project/" plain, "" worktree) is stripped so the hub / project:<name> / all filters work on store-relative paths in both layouts; _generate_hub_commit_message probes "/"+path so "stories/X.md" is still recognised. push_hub now calls _push_store_branch after a successful main push when the store is a worktree; result carries pm_store and a failed store push fails the call; pm_push(scope=hub) passes it through. Hub fixture in tests uses a real git submodule at projects/api: TestHubCommit (8), TestHubNoSubmoduleNoise (4: .project never a gitlink, submodule pointer and main untouched, submodule checkout clean), TestHubPush (6).
